summary: Add configurable duplicate-alert suppression for POST /api/alerts using a 15-minute active-alert window by title and severity.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /api/alerts suppresses creation when an active alert exists with the same title (case-insensitive) and same severity, and the existing alert was created within the configured suppression window.
When suppression occurs, API returns 200 OK with the existing alert payload and response header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true.
When no suppressible duplicate exists, API keeps normal create behavior and returns 201 Created with CreatedAtRoute.
Suppression does not apply when severity differs or when prior matching alert is inactive.
Suppression window minutes are configurable from appsettings.json and not hardcoded in code paths.

constraints: No unrelated refactoring outside duplicate suppression behavior for POST /api/alerts.
Duplicate match must be case-insensitive for title and exact match for severity.
Suppression candidate must be active and within configured time window based on CreatedDate.
Suppression response must include X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true and HTTP 200.
Normal creation path must remain 201 Created when no suppressible duplicate exists.
Suppression window must come from appsettings configuration, not literals in runtime logic.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage for duplicate-suppressed POST returning 200 and suppression header.
Behavior coverage for normal POST create path returning 201 when no duplicate exists.
Behavior coverage for non-suppression cases (inactive prior alert, different severity, outside window).
Behavior coverage for repository duplicate lookup with case-insensitive title match and time window boundary.
unresolved_questions: When multiple active duplicates match within the window, should suppression return the newest match, oldest match, or any deterministic match?
